subject.title: Workspace file injector does not follow symlinks

question: Should fixed workspace bootstrap files be allowed to follow symlinks outside the workspace root, and if so under what explicit trust policy?
rationale: The failure is source-reproducible, but allowing external symlink targets changes which local files can become startup prompt authority and the active PR has unresolved security/product review concerns.

options.title: Land a narrow bootstrap-only exception
options.body: Allow only fixed bootstrap files to read explicitly symlinked regular-file targets while preserving hardlink, non-regular, dangling, oversized, private-state, and extra-bootstrap rejection tests.

options.title: Keep strict boundary and improve diagnostics
options.body: Continue blocking external symlink targets but render boundary-blocked bootstrap files differently from missing files so users can diagnose the setup.

options.title: Require configured allowlist
options.body: Add or reuse an explicit trusted-path policy before loading external symlink targets, accepting the extra config surface and upgrade documentation burden.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow bootstrap-only exception
recommendation.body: Allow only fixed bootstrap files to read explicitly symlinked regular-file targets while preserving hardlink, non-regular, dangling, oversized, private-state, and extra-bootstrap rejection tests.
